title: Kickboxer
description: An American kickboxer trains with an Asian master to avenge his crippled brother in Thailand.

title: Future World
description: A queen lays dying as her son, Prince, travels across a barren wasteland to find a near-mythical medicine to save her life. He soon finds himself in an epic battle against the Warlord and his henchmen to save the last remnants of humanity.

title: End of a Gun
description: A former DEA agent (Steven Seagal) strikes a deal to help a mysterious and seductive woman steal $2 million from a sadistic drug lord.

title: The Asian Connection
description: Two American expats, Jack and Sam, become the targets of a Southeast Asian gang's vengeance when they unwittingly steal a drug lord's money.

title: Missing in Action
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) escapes from the Viet Cong, then comes back with a floating arsenal to get others out.

title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
description: An imprisoned U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) fights the military overlord (Oh Soon-tek) of a slave-labor opium operation in Vietnam.

title: Braddock: Missing in Action III
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) returns to Vietnam and fights his way out with his wife, son (Roland Harrah III) and Amerasian orphans.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: A Force of One
description: A veteran (Chuck Norris) teaches martial arts to a California detective (Jennifer O'Neill) and her colleagues, and joins them on a case.

title: Gladiator Underground
description: Two brothers compete in the world's deadliest underground fighting tournament, where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E10 — That's a Wrap on Production!
Scarlet breaks down when her child actor's role in her film is compromised; tensions between Bola and her DP escalate when she questions his shot selection, culminating in a confrontation.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E11 — Post Production Begins
The filmmakers begin post-production and are tasked by Robert to cut a sizzle reel of their movies.

title: Camp Cold Brook
description: Strange events plague crew members of a reality TV show when they visit an infamous backwoods camp that was the site of a mass murder 20 years earlier.

title: Walking Tall: The Payback
description: A man (Kevin Sorbo) discovers a link between the mysterious death of his father and a gang of murderous thugs.

title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
description: A criminal organization kidnaps a young man with amnesia and turns him into a ruthless assassin.

title: BloodRayne
description: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her.

title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

title: Bleeding Steel
description: Hong Kong police inspector Lin Dong learns that a biochemical invention has been surgically implanted into his missing daughter. With help from a hacker, Lin tries to connect the dots between the device, a sinister army and a strange phenomenon.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
description: A retired Texas Ranger pursues a killer named Leatherface and his family of chainsaw-wielding cannibals.

title: Candyman 3
description: A woman (Donna D'Errico) tries to disprove a legend that her ancestor (Tony Todd) can appear and kill people with his hook.

title: Villains
description: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

title: Accident Man
description: Mike Fallon is a seasoned hit man who is known for making his target's death look like an accident. When Fallon's girlfriend turns up dead, he goes after his old colleagues to find the one responsible.

title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
description: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world to protect the ungrateful son of a mafia boss, save the life of his only friend, and rekindle his relationship with his maniacal father figure.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E08 — La Conquista
Freddie confronts Carlos; Seth, the Fullers and Sex Machine battle farther into the temple.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E09 — Boxman
Seth and Richie face the labyrinth in the temple; Jacob and Kate confront Scott's transformation; Freddie uncovers a new lead.

title: The Fast and the Fierce
description: When terrorists plant a bomb on a commercial flight, the passengers must fight to keep the plane in the air and everyone alive. If they let the plane dip below 800 feet, the bomb will go off and kill everyone.

title: Take Back
description: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: Ip Man
description: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.

title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
description: Wing Chun martial arts master Ip Man moves to Hong Kong to create a school where he can teach his fighting techniques to a new generation. Instead, he's drawn into a showdown with a merciless boxer known as the Twister.

title: Ip Man 3
description: Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.

title: Safe
description: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: American Sicario
description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

title: The Boondock Saints
description: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.

title: Contract Killer
description: A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.

title: Dead Snow 2: Red vs. Dead
description: Martin mistakenly thinks things could not get worse after he kills his girlfriend with an ax, cuts off his arm with a chainsaw, and watches his friends be devoured by Nazi zombies.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E01 — Meet the Filmmakers
Five first-time filmmakers are thrust into the world of pre-production and tasked with choosing locations; an alluring location leaves one filmmaker considering rewriting his entire script.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E10 — The Take
Seth and Richie find they've been double-crossed; the Fullers confront their demons; Freddie makes a decision.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E01 — Opening Night
Three months after freeing Santanico from the Titty Twister, the Gecko Brothers are still on the run; Seth and Kate are lost in Mexico; Richie and Santanico plot vengeance on the culebra Lord.

title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

title: The Delta Force
description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

description: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.

title: American Sicario
description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Timecop
description: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Dangerous
description: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

title: From Paris With Love
description: A low-ranking agent (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) joins forces with a trigger-happy operative (John Travolta) to stop a terrorist attack in France.

title: Speed Kills
description: A wealthy speedboat racer leads a double life that gets him into trouble with the law and drug lords.

title: Nightbreed
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.
